We’re here to help 24/7
Fetch Specialty & Emergency Veterinary Centers is proud to offer tailored specialty and emergency services to the pet families of
Greenville
. Our goal is to support the needs of you and your pet by partnering with your regular veterinarian and serving as an extension of your pet’s routine care. With our board-certified veterinary specialists and access to innovative technology,
Fetch
is equipped to diagnose, treat, and manage a wide variety of challenging medical issues in pets. Coupled with our love for animals and people and a commitment to the highest standard of treatment, you can expect your pet to be in the best hands with us.

Pet Emergency Services in Greenville, SC
If your pet needs to see an emergency vet, our Greenville, SC team is available 24 hours a day, every day (even holidays) to help. We understand the unpredictability of pet emergencies and strive to give you the reliable support you and your pet need. You deserve to have peace of mind and a capable vet team that’s just a phone call away! Should you ever need knowledgeable guidance or immediate care for your pet, get in touch with Fetch. For more information about emergency care, click below!

Electrochemotherapy
Electrochemotherapy
Electrochemotherapy is an innovative treatment option that combines chemotherapy with the power of electrical pulses to target and treat certain types of cancer in pets. This advanced procedure involves injecting a chemotherapy drug directly into the tumor, followed by brief, controlled electrical pulses. The electricity helps the medication reach the cancer cells more effectively, improving its therapeutic effects. Electrochemotherapy offers a promising new approach for treating localized or superficial tumors in pets, providing a more precise, targeted solution with fewer side effects than traditional chemotherapy. It’s an exciting step forward in veterinary oncology and Fetch is proud to be one of the few hospitals able to offer this treatment.
